item.content:encoded:
When I first entered the Infosys Mysore campus, I was still a college student. I had come to Mysore campus for my internship. Until then I was a college student, who was used to a typical lifestyle of a hostellite. The luxury of Laundromats, room service, hygienic food, state of the art learning facility and much more was something never heard of. The Mysore campus came as quite a surprise for all of us. From the moment I entered the campus until this date I can’t stop talking about it. The place is definition of beauty, aesthetics, modernization, discipline and wonder.

MY DC

To write the entire Mysore training story will take pages, and I will still be left with so much to tell. In this post I will simply make note of what I loved when I lived there. I must really appreciate the efforts of Infosys founders and all those who were involved in building this monumental campus. The campus has given a reason for thousands to appreciate something and dream big in their life. It has generated valuable jobs for the people of Mysore.

Roman architecture

The campus is an architectural masterpiece. Every building is part of a design, and just doesn’t stand there. The colossal GECII inspired by Roman architecture, the origami building, The Multiplex are nothing less than a work of art. The campus has 8 food courts, each food court is unique, lovely and grand. They even have beautiful names. An aerial view of the campus will show the name Infosys where hostels are located. The hostels are located in such a fashion so as to create the name Infosys. There is greenery everywhere, nothing is out of place. One can even spot several birds in the campus.

One thing that I loved most than any other was my room. The huge window, an awesome sofa and a cup of coffee was an irresistible combination. There was more than sufficient furniture. I still miss the cozy bed, the Raymond blanket and silky smooth bed spread. Had an LCD TV all for myself which was quite frankly all I could have asked for. The bathroom was equally beautiful and provided hot water in the morning. :)The best part was we could order a pizza using the intercom and be as lazy as we would want. My room even had a wooden flooring; That was just way to rich.

One gets friends of a life time at Mysore campus. Mysore days are days of celebration and celebration is incomplete without friends. Everyone enjoys and suffers the same condition at the campus and that makes friendship all the more powerful. The strict rules of the campus calls up for many adventures which would be impossible without help from your close friends. The adventures are a plenty and would take a whole new blog post. All days at the campus are full of fun, humor, adventure, satire, wonderful crushes and much more.

I knew how to swim, but I still wouldn’t call myself a swimmer. Here I learnt proper strokes with help of a trainer. In the end could swim 25mts underwater, and later at one occasion even swam 2000mts in a single go. The extra-curricular activities in the campus is the biggest attraction. There is in-house bowling alley, Bouldering Wall, basketball, volleyball, badminton court, Football ground surrounded by synthetic jogging track. Cricket ground, pool, carrom, lawn tennis, squash, table tennis, a gym facility, yoga room and many more. It’s kind of you name it and we have it. More so everything is state of the art facility.

Multiplex

The entire facility is called ECC – Employee Care Center. There is a multiplex inside the campus which plays all the latest movies. Then there is a small retail store called Loyal World which caters to most of the shopping needs of the residents. There is everything one can ask for, and some more. It was left with every individual how to make judicious use of all these facilities. If one wishes to learn what quality is? Then the person should come to this place. Be it lawn-mowing at cricket ground, or the quality of plumbing used at various places, quality is not compromised for any reason. The house keeping staff literally washes the streets to keep it clean and beautiful.

The campus is meant to be house for thousands of people who will come and go. So it is of utmost importance to provide such a facility which will last for very long. The house keeping takes the motto “prevention is better than cure” very seriously. Every room, every corner, every door is meticulously cleaned day in day out. So as to avoid any unforeseeable complication.

All glamor and glitz apart the campus is a place for exceptional world class training facility. The class rooms are simply amazing. The quality of trainers and the training material is equally amazing. If I were to really make a statement, I would say, all the coding that I can do today. I learnt it here. Thanks to all my friends for their great support when I was as dumb as anyone could be. I couldn’t even write a basic SQL query in the beginning, but the training process and a little hard work paid off. Mysore days were truly the best days of my life and will cherish them forever. Thanks to all my batch mates, you guys made it special.

item.title: First Half Marathon
item.description: Physical activity is an important aspect of our life. As we age we give less and less importance to this aspect under the pretext of priorities. item.content:encoded:
Physical activity is an important aspect of our life. As we age we give less and less importance to this aspect under the pretext of priorities. I decided to run a marathon to provide myself a reminder for the rest of my life. A reminder of being mentally and physically strong, a reason to start working out again whenever I lose touch. To do it at least once so that it will inspire me for a lifetime. My inspiration was my best friend who in spite of a knee injury and a one year rest to recover from subsequent surgery came out strong and ran his first half marathon.

Although I registered for the marathon, the work kept me busy. It was difficult finding time for training. I was working out after quite a long time and suffered few injuries in the course of training too. The real preparation from my side I can say, was only buying a pair of beautiful Adidas jogging shoes.

A day prior to marathon, I had to go to office due to an urgent requirement. After finishing my work I traveled from Pune to Mumbai. Reached Mumbai around 10:30pm for a stay at friend’s place. The other two of my buddies also arrived. We had a heavy dinner and we kept chatting until 1:00am in the morning. We were to report at the marathon venue at 5:30am in the morning, so even if we were to wake up at 4:30 in the morning we would have had only 3 and half hours of sleep. At this point I was getting bugged by the thought of not having taken adequate rest. By the morning I had my own doubts if I could even make it.

We reached in time to the venue. Had our luggage secured at the luggage desk. Then the marathon started without any delay. I had a only goal in mind to go as slow as possible and to complete the marathon. Even if I were to walk the entire distance which I could have done easily I could do it in 3 hours, so thought to myself, yes this is possible. As the running progressed, I found myself more comfortable and started to gradually increase my pace. As I started to overtake few of the fellow marathoners my confidence grew. There were people on the streets cheering, volunteers providing water and lemon juice. Feeling was special.

After a very long run, saw a board with a bold 9km on it. I had not run a marathon before, so the sign was free for my misinterpretation. I thought I was only left with 9kms now. 🙂 As I misread the signboard, I increased my pace again, I was under the impression it were only a matter of 9kms now, and I must have already completed 12kms. From then on after a long tiresome run with increased pace, saw a new signboard with bold 15km, and my hopes were dashed. Took me no time to realize that back then I had completed only 9kms. Now the pace dropped, It was brutal from this moment.

The last 6kms were absolutely excruciating. Although my mind was ready, my legs couldn’t support the stress. There were moments when I wondered at my pace and thought even a walker by will overtake me at this speed. More than 100 marathoners ran past me in this stretch. Few ran alongside me and cheered me to push a little and I did. I could have stopped midway, but the all-powerful mind kept persistent. I pushed myself to the limit. As I look at it now, it was quite naive. I was exposing myself to some serious injury. But that had never been a concern ever for me. Suffered cramps in last 1km and almost tripped at one point. All in all I was very glad to complete the run in 2hours 9 minutes.

One should have this experience at least once in life. The participants are special, the half marathon participants are mostly office going men and women who take time from their daily routine to take care of their physique too. They train themselves in spite of challenges put forth by their working lifestyles. It feels great to be among such inspired crowd. All special thanks to the organizing committee. To arrange such a huge event requires tremendous planning, infrastructure and volunteers. The whole experience inspires me to prepare for the next big run. There is an ecstasy of overcoming your limitations, pride of achievement. A stronger sense of self belief.

I should not forget to mention, training for such events is absolutely essential. Only mental preparedness is not enough. There was a fatality in the event I ran, and that should not happen to anybody. The participants should really work on the ground realities before signing up for such events. There is always a dream run of 8kms for the folks who do not wish to experience the strain put forth by half and full marathon. For 3 days post marathon it was difficult for me to even walk. I couldn’t climb or descend the stairs without the support of railings. I was lucky I didn’t suffer any lasting injury, but a lesson was learnt. Next time I will be more prepared both mentally and physically to meet the challenge.

item.content:encoded:
If any subject has given better solutions to our relentless Meta physical questions regarding life and it’s manifestations, there is none better than Mathematics. Mathematicians for over thousand years have been coming up with abstract mathematical equations which may or may not really hold any relevance to our lives as such. Even though these formulas or equations were created in a different time-frame and without any material base, it’s interesting how they perfectly fit into definition of our daily lives.

One mathematician I particularly like is Pythagoras. The first 4 numbers defined in Pythagoras tradition, are pretty much capable of describing the entire world.

The dot or number 1 represent the beginning of the universe. It’s the first transition from unknown to the known.
The line created by connecting 2 dots gives birth to number 2 and the one dimensional reality.
The triangle or any plane can be defined by three points not lying on a single line. The number 3 gives birth to the two dimensional reality.
The number four, which can be considered combination of above three numbers defines the 3-dimensional reality into which we reside.

Our entire understanding of the world can be described using these 4 numbers alone. An entirely new number system can be found using number 4 as base. It’s interesting how mathematics can so accurately define our life, although its subject matter was not necessarily created with the purpose of making any material sense at all. We cannot prove the right angle triangle equation using physical objects as it’s impossible to create perfect right angle triangle, still the equation holds true and is part of our everyday solutions.

The famous Right angle triangle equation, the fabled irrational number pi (22/7) which defines all the circles, the Fibonacci series which defines the pattern in a sea shell, or the formation of leaves on some trees, the probability theory which defines a lot of our life, and also the activity at sub-atomic level, beautiful equations  which define the planetary moments, also the activity of entire cosmos as such. Though these formulas weren’t created with the purpose of defining materialism, the material reality seems to perfectly fit into their definition.

Let me confess I don’t understand much of mathematics. However there is something about this subject that has left me in such awe and wonder. Like music it doesn’t matter if I don’t understand the process of creation of mathematical entities. I know the taste, I know how the world around me has been transformed as result of its application. I can almost certainly enjoy it. 🙂

item.content:encoded:
From improving your posture, strengthening muscles to whittling extra inches around the waist, the benefits of Suryanamaskar are many, provided you adapt it the right way. A set of 12 fixed, cyclic postures define Suryanamaskar which when performed repeatedly at an easy pace can bring a sense of wellbeing, almost immediately. However, those with a heart condition, arthritis or slip-disk, need their doctor’s consent before starting the routine. If you have been gravely out of form in a way that you haven’t stretched your muscles in ages, first give your body some time to open up, which you can do with some flexibility and stamina-building exercises before embarking on the more arduous ‘Suryanamaskar’.

And once your body has registered a certain fitness level, you can begin with a set of three Suryanamaskars in the first instance and increase it to five then ten and more depending on your stamina. Any more than clocking up numbers, it is important to get each posture right, for the very essence of this yogic ritual lies in perfecting every move. To say the least, it can be an uphill task for beginners. But our expert-backed warm-up exercises are sure to make Suryanamaskar less strenuous and ever so graceful.

Benefits I have experienced.

  1. Graceful posture
  2. Fluid body movements
  3. Improved Stamina
  4. Perfect body balance and better reflexes
  5. Improved core strength
  6. Better breath control
